question_text: Outline two differences between supervised classification and unsupervised clustering when analysing image features.
adaptation_rationale: Rebuilt scenario and response wording while retaining the supported reasoning; source-specific obsolete material excluded.
solution: Classification learns from image features paired with known class labels and predicts those defined categories. Clustering receives features without target labels and groups images by similarity; a person must interpret what the groups represent.

marking_points.criterion: Clustering discovers similarity groups requiring interpretation.
